system.notes:
This fearsome foe is a floating skull graven with runes. Embedded with rubies, emeralds, and gems.

AC 16, HP 40, ATK 1 soul trap or 1 telekinetic storm, MV near (fly), S -4, D +2, C +0, I +3, W +3, Ch +4, AL C, LV 9

Grave Spirit. Unless reduced to 0 HP and remains have bless or dispel magic cast on them, or doused with holy water, demilich rejuvenates at full HP in 2d6 days.

Insurmountable. Immune to hostile spells of 4th tier or lower.

Soul Trap. CHA 15+ or the demilich sucks out and traps the soul of a mortal within near in one of the demilich's gems. The mortal's body dissolves and turns into dust in 1d4 rounds.

Supreme Undead. Immune to morale checks. Only damaged by magical sources.

Telekinetic Storm. For 5 rounds, debris and dust fills a near-sized cube centered on demilich. Mortal creatures inside cloud are blinded and take 2d6 damage per round.

Shadowfinder Complete Bestiary
